provenance.procedure: Reconstruct four-worker occupancy from the ordered completion records. Each completion releases its worker and immediately starts the next manifest index. Record the active file set when the HTTP file starts and every completion before it ends.

additionalDiagnosticProjection.procedure: Project comparator error sites from completed whole-file observations. Named assertion pass/failure vectors remain those parsed from the original complete reports. Repeated error occurrences are retained.

observations.reason: No final comparator verdict; neither an individual error identity nor a pass is inferred.

boundedReports.procedure: Streaming projection retains every field consumed by the repository parser, all testcase identities, flags, root totals and unnamed hook messages. Original bytes remain unchanged. Omitted named assertion messages and unused bodies are outside the comparator input.

head.projection: Preserves every parser-consumed identity, flag, root total and hook message; omits bodies and named assertion messages unused by the repository comparator.

main.projection: Preserves every parser-consumed identity, flag, root total and hook message; omits bodies and named assertion messages unused by the repository comparator.

interleavingProof.procedure: Insert a newline between a Bun status-line duration and the directly attached, file-specific registry timer or board M.9 diagnostic. Retain every byte of diagnostic text; require case identities, totals and exit agreement.

consoleProjection.procedure: Parse whole-file Bun console statuses in fixed declaration order; preserve skips, hook diagnostics and between-tests errors; require case counts and exit/report agreement. Differentially checked against the repository JUnit parser on all fourteen original reports.
